help_intro_text: This portal lets you track your project's progress and communicate directly with the supplier in one place. The portal link is permanent — you can come back to it any time and log in with the same password the supplier gave you.
help_description_text: Here you'll find the basic information about the project — its description, the technologies used, and the estimated completion date (if the supplier has set one). The date is shown as a range, since it may shift slightly as work progresses.
help_checkpoints_text: Here you can see the project's individual steps (checkpoints) and their current status: Not started, In progress, or Done. The bar at the top shows how many steps are complete out of the total. Checkpoint status is updated by the supplier — you can only view it here.
help_threads_text: All written communication with the supplier happens here, organized into separate threads (conversations) by topic — similar to email threads.
help_threads_new_text: Click "New thread" to start a new conversation. Fill in a subject, choose a priority (low, medium, high, or critical), and describe your request. You can optionally attach files right away.
help_threads_reply_text: Once you open a thread, you'll see the full message history. Type your reply in the box at the bottom and send it with the "Send" button. While a thread is open, new replies from the supplier appear automatically — no need to refresh the page.
help_threads_status_text: Every thread has a status of Active or Closed. You can change it yourself at any time using the dropdown at the top of the thread — for example, mark a thread as Closed once your request is resolved, or reopen it if you closed it by mistake or want to return to the topic. Closing a thread does not stop you from sending further messages in it.
help_attachments_text: You can attach up to 5 files (documents, images, archives, etc.) to a new thread or to individual replies, each up to 15 MB. Attached files appear next to the message as a download link.
help_unread_text: If the supplier replies to your message, a red badge with the number of unread messages appears on the Communication tab and on the relevant thread. The badge disappears once you open the thread.
help_search_text: The "Search communication" field searches both thread subjects and the text of every message inside them — handy when you need to find where you discussed something.
help_contacts_text: Here you'll find the supplier's billing and company details — company name, registered address, company ID, VAT ID, and contact information.
help_actions_text: The "Refresh data" button in the left panel manually pulls the latest project state, even though most data updates automatically in the background. The "Log out" button ends your current session — you can log in again using the same password the supplier gave you.
help_language_text: You can switch the portal's language at any time by clicking the flag in the left panel.
help_support_text: If you're not sure how to do something, send a new message in the Communication tab, or use the supplier's contact details shown in the left panel.
